q: My GHG report shows net emissions after subtracting carbon offsets. Is that allowed?
title: Can offsets be subtracted in a GHG report?
short: No. A GHG inventory reports gross emissions by scope. Carbon credits you bought and retired are reported separately, with the registry, project and quantity, never subtracted from Scope 1, 2 or 3. If you make a carbon neutral claim, show the gross footprint and the credits retired side by side.
audience: MSMEs and exporters reviewing a consultant's report or a supplier's figure

ul: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard: scopes are reported as gross figures; offsets bought or sold are optional information reported separately.
ISO 14064-1: the inventory reports emissions and removals within your boundary; purchased credits are not part of it.
SBTi: credits do not count toward a near-term reduction target.
BRSR: Scope 1 and 2 are disclosed as gross emissions.

ol: Below them, list credits retired in the period: quantity, registry, project ID, vintage and serial numbers.
If you claim carbon neutrality for a product, event or the company, name the standard you follow, such as ISO 14068-1, and its reduction requirements.

sections.h: Why netting is a red flag
p: A net figure hides whether emissions actually fell. A buyer comparing suppliers, or a lender checking a sustainability-linked loan KPI, needs the gross number, and a netted figure is likely to be questioned. In the EU, product claims of neutral or reduced impact based on offsetting are banned from 27 September 2026.

sections.h: Removals inside your boundary are different
p: Carbon removed on land you own, such as trees on your premises, is reported as removals separately from emissions under ISO 14064-1. It is still not subtracted inside a scope total.

example.title: Worked example: presenting credits next to the inventory
lines: Credits retired in the year: 300 t, listed with registry, project and serial numbers
Correct: report 1,200 t and, separately, 300 t of credits retired
Wrong: report net emissions of 900 t

senseible: Senseible reports gross Scope 1, 2 and 3 figures built from your documents. Carbon credit eligibility signals and marketplace listings sit separately and are never deducted from the inventory.
